import sys,time,unittest
sys.path.insert(0,'scripts')
import run_profiled_d0 as d

 suite.addTests(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('scripts',pattern=pattern))

d.write_new(d.ROOT/'results/lora_profiled_d0_v1/synthetic_checks01.json',report)
raise SystemExit(0 if report['pass_all'] else 1)
